newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Imperial to renovate Turkmen oil wells.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Imperial to renovate Turkmen oil wells.

text.p: Turkey's Imperial Group is to rehabilitate 30 oil wells in the former Soviet republic of Turkmenistan and plans to improve a further 500 wells, the official Turkmen-Press news agency said on Monday.
Imperial Group head, Murat Topal, told the agency the company would renovate 30 wells in the Gotur-Depe and Gun-Dag fields, in the west of the desert nation, which borders Iran.
He said the company, together with Turkmenistan's Balkannebit enterprise, had plans to rehabilitate a further 500 wells, but gave no details on costs.
Earlier this month, Mobil Corp and Britain's Monument Oil and Gas Plc 0#MOG.L secured a deal to rehabilitate 2,000 oil wells in the country's western Balkan region.
Output from Turkmenistan's Soviet-era wells has lagged since independence in 1991, down from 5.4 million tonnes in 1991 to 3.5 million tonnes in 1995.

Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov said last week that output this year stood at 3.2 million tonnes (about 64,000 barrels per day) of oil so far, below the targeted 5.0 million tonnes (100,000 bpd).
